finding: The pinned InternNav Habitat eval configs are incompatible with habitat-lab 0.3.3.
evidence_method: For each habitat-lab git tag: (1) HTTP status of habitat-lab/habitat/config/habitat/simulator/agents/rgbd_agent.yaml, (2) presence of `tilt_angle` and `action_space_config` as SimulatorConfig fields in habitat-lab/habitat/config/default_structured_configs.py.

v0.2.5.verdict: partial - tilt_angle moved to action configs, action_space_config dropped

v0.3.3.verdict: incompatible - the version built and tested this session

observed_failures_on_0_3_3_in_order: MissingConfigException: Could not find 'habitat/simulator/agents/rgbd_agent' (node exists but under group 'habitat/simulator/sensor_setups')
ConfigKeyError: Key 'tilt_angle' not in 'SimulatorConfig' (relocated to look_up/look_down action configs, same default 15)
ConfigKeyError: Key 'action_space_config' not in 'SimulatorConfig' (removed after v0.2.4)
conclusion: habitat-lab v0.2.4 (or v0.2.3) is the version these configs were authored against. habitat-lab 0.3.3 was chosen this session only because it is the tag matching habitat-sim 0.3.3, which the repo also does not pin.
status: DIAGNOSED, NOT VERIFIED END-TO-END. No habitat-lab v0.2.4 environment was built or run.
recommended_next_step: Build an isolated env with habitat-sim 0.2.4 + habitat-lab v0.2.4 and re-run official_r2r/scripts/preflight_official.py against the faithful derived config. This is independent of the MP3D blocker and can be done before the data arrives.
repo_gap: The pinned InternNav repo pins NO habitat-lab or habitat-sim version anywhere in requirements/ or setup.py extras; requirements/habitat_requirements.txt lists only model-side packages. This is a reproducibility gap in the upstream repository.

code_level_evidence.why_required: habitat_vln_evaluator.py imports internnav.habitat_extensions.vln.measures for Habitat registry side effects (its own comment says 'do not remove'), so this import cannot be skipped.

combined_conclusion: Config evidence narrows to v0.2.3/v0.2.4 (agents/rgbd_agent group + tilt_angle + action_space_config on SimulatorConfig). Code evidence independently excludes v0.3.3 (try_cv2_import removed). The intersection is habitat-lab v0.2.3 or v0.2.4; v0.2.4 is the strongest candidate.

python_deps_also_missing_from_package_se.note: The execution package's setup script installed model-side pins only. The official evaluator import chain additionally needs InternNav core_requirements packages.
python_deps_also_missing_from_package_se.reason_fetched_locally: files.pythonhosted.org repeatedly timed out on the rented host.
